items.summary: Holst’s The Planets premiered in 1918, 12 years before Pluto was discovered. So in 2000 Colin Matthews wrote an eighth movement, “Pluto, the Renewer,” to complete the cycle. (I’m not sure of its status since 2006, when the International Astronomical Union reclassified Pluto a dwarf planet.)
items.author: Greg Ross

items.title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
items.summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve.
items.excerpt: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution.
items.author: Ruopeng Gao, Yukun Huang, Jiarui Hu

items.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
items.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost.
items.excerpt: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth.
